name: Tooltip
description: A small floating label attached to a trigger, shown on hover and on focus. It owns the show/hide debounce and the positioning; you give it the control to attach to via the `trigger` slot and the text via the default slot.

props.name: ariaDescribedBy
props.description:
Aria Described By attribute
- Dynamically set for A11y

props.name: hasArrow
props.description: Displays the arrow on the tooltip container

props.name: isActive
props.description:
Is active?
- **true** Shows the tooltip container
- **false** Hides the tooltip container

props.name: isDynamic
props.description:
Is dynamic?
- **true** Dynamically position the tooltip container based on it's position in the viewport
- **false** Positions the tooltip container based on the position property

props.name: isInteractive
props.description:
Is interactive?
- **true** Tooltip container is visible on click and not hover/focus
- **false** Tooltip container is visible on hover/focus

props.name: position
props.description:
Positions the dropdown tooltip absolutely to the trigger.
- **default** places the tooltip to the top
- **top** places the tooltip to the top
- **bottom** places the tooltip to the bottom
- **left** places the tooltip to the left
- **right** places the tooltip to the right

events.name: onTooltipClose
events.description: Fired when the tooltip hides. Detail: `{ active }`.

events.name: onTooltipOpen
events.description: Fired when the tooltip becomes visible. Detail: `{ active }`.

slots.description: The content that appears inside the tooltip

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: The content that appears before the main content

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The trigger that opens the tooltip

keyboard.action: Closes the tooltip. Only while it is open.
Closes the tooltip as focus moves on.

a11y.focus: Focus ring drawn from the shared focus treatment.
